description: Read the user's CarlNotes updates: the unread findings Carl would read next across the topics they follow, or on one topic, trimmed to 5, 15, or 30 minutes of reading. Every finding it returns counts as read, so the next call moves on. Use it for requests like what's new, catch me up, update me, or what's new on a topic. Call it once for each time the user asks.

minutes.description: How many minutes of updates to read: 5, 15, or 30. Leave it out for 15.

topic_id.description: One topic to read updates on. Leave it out for every topic the user follows.

name: read_updates
title: Read updates
